subject.title: [Bug]: 飞书发图片或文件 常常出问题 要么不会发，要么重复发

question: Should this broad Feishu media report remain open as an umbrella while maintainers collect exact repro details, or should it be collapsed into one narrower Feishu media item now?
rationale: The current evidence overlaps multiple open Feishu media subpaths and does not explain duplicate sends, so automation cannot safely choose a single canonical root cause or close target.

options.title: Keep open and request exact repro
options.body: Keep this issue open, ask for the exact message-tool payload or MEDIA directive, media source, credential shape, chat mode, Feishu error/logs, and duplicate send counts, then route it to the confirmed narrower item.

options.title: Collapse into SecretRef media issue
options.body: Treat the missing-send part as covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89338 if the reporter confirms SecretRef-backed Feishu credentials.

options.title: Collapse into multipart upload issue
options.body: Treat the missing-send part as covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95291 if the reporter confirms CDN/ECONNRESET upload failures from the message tool.

recommendation.title: Keep open and request exact repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, ask for the exact message-tool payload or MEDIA directive, media source, credential shape, chat mode, Feishu error/logs, and duplicate send counts, then route it to the confirmed narrower item.
